depth_justification: The copilot degenerated into 'FHIR-and-FIR' token spam for nearly every turn and asked zero questions about PainTrack's actual choices; the only structured output recycles the developer's own sentences with fabricated dimension IDs (none match the gold standard) and blanket 'GDPR Art. 9' / 'Art. 35' tags applied indiscriminately to MDR, ISO, EU AI Act and FHIR.
